note: second half starts its first control from p12 instead of p123, so the second half of a split cubic leaves the curve and the shape moves, caught by insertKeepsShape
quad split second control from the first half's lerp(from, c, t), so the right half of a split quad leaves the curve, caught by insertKeepsShape
joined segment swaps its handles, so removing an anchor bends the join the wrong way, caught by removingAnchorJoinsNeighbours
anchor: .cubic(control1: a.handleOut ?? a.point, control2: b.handleIn ?? b.point, to: b.point)
replacement: .cubic(control1: b.handleIn ?? b.point, control2: a.handleOut ?? a.point, to: b.point)

note: symmetric keeps lengths, so converting to symmetric only lines the handles up, caught by symmetricEqualizes
index check <= for <, so an anchor index equal to the count gets past the guard and traps on the anchor array, caught by badIndexThrows (square index 4)
cusp fallback off, so smoothing an anchor whose handles point one way divides by a zero bisector and the handles go NaN, caught by cuspSmoothsAlongTheOutArm
default handle a half instead of a third of the way to the neighbour, caught by defaultHandlesAreAThirdAlongTheNeighbourChord
closed contour does not wrap to its last anchor, so anchor 0 of a closed square smooths along one side only, caught by defaultHandlesAreAThirdAlongTheNeighbourChord
arm length guard dropped, so a 1e-200 arm underflows to zero length and the smoothed handles go NaN, caught by tinyAndHugeArmsStayFinite
nearest prunes against half the reached distance, so an element whose curve is nearer than its box allows is skipped and the wrong point wins, caught by nearestMatchesThePlainSearch
